Below us, the Metal God.

I amplified the nodachi's gravity and swept the incoming wave aside with one stroke—

A hair's difference, and all I would have done was wave my sword uselessly before dying. But that difference did not happen.
There had barely been time even to aim. What else was I supposed to call it but a miracle?

en.text:
...From outside, it did not seem to have changed.

In the beginning, calling that god intelligent would have been an act of charity. A child swinging a toy about—that was a fair assessment.

But what it had just done...

Cut down those pointlessly overpowered gravity blasts and switched to rapid fire, each shot carrying just enough force.◆
When I withdrew, bent space exactly where I was going.◆
Then sent one more gravity wave to finish us.

If that was coincidence, coincidence had become a master artist.

No. Those were tactics.
However many ways I went over those last few seconds, the same problem remained. Something was THINKING in there. And the thinking had a very human smell to it.

……外観に変化は無いようだ。

　あの〝神〟の行動は当初、知的と云うに遠かった。
　玩具を振り回す子供、そう評価を下して差し支えは
ない。

　しかし。
　今、〝神〟がとった行動――

　無意味なほどの破壊力があった重力波を絞り、単発
から必要充分な威力による連射へ切り替え。◆
　俺が撤退すれば、退避点に空間歪曲を仕掛け。◆
　更に、詰み手となる重力波一射。

　偶然にしては、芸術の域まで出来過ぎている。

　あれは戦術的行動であった。
　過去数秒間の出来事をどう反芻しどう考察しようが、
極めて人間臭い・・・・思考の介在なしには説明がつかない。
